scenario.topic: Which drone should the film club buy for aerial shots

options.name: DJI Air 2S
options.upside: Offers high-resolution video and long flight time.

options.name: Autel Robotics EVO Nano+
options.concern: Camera sensor size is smaller, affecting low-light performance.

options.name: Skydio 2+
options.upside: Advanced obstacle avoidance for safer flights.

shared_context: The film club needs a drone suitable for capturing aerial shots during outdoor events. The drone must have a camera with at least 4K resolution, a flight time of 20 minutes or more, and easy portability for travel to various locations.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a film student passionate about lightweight gear for easy travel.
personas.private_goal: Find a drone that balances portability with solid 4K video quality.

A.reason_for: Offers high-resolution 5.4K video and long flight time.
A.reason_against: Heavier weight reduces portability, which Maya dislikes.

B.reason_for: Lightweight design enhances portability and meets 4K requirement.

C.reason_against: Heaviest drone and shorter range make it less portable.

D.reason_for: Combines long flight time with lightweight portability.
D.reason_against: Smaller sensor may limit image quality in challenging lighting.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is the club’s lead videographer focused on image quality and flight duration.
personas.private_goal: Choose the drone that delivers the best overall footage quality and endurance.

A.reason_for: High-resolution 5.4K camera and long 31-minute flight time.
A.reason_against: Heavier weight may hinder travel convenience.

B.reason_against: Smaller sensor affects image quality, especially in low light.

C.reason_against: Heavy and shorter range reduce usability outdoors.

D.reason_for: Long flight time and lightweight design ideal for outdoor shoots.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe is a cautious drone pilot who values safety and reliability during shoots.
personas.private_goal: Prioritize drones with strong obstacle avoidance and stable flight.

A.reason_for: Excellent camera resolution and flight time.
A.reason_against: Heavier weight and less obstacle avoidance make it less safe.

C.reason_for: Advanced obstacle avoidance ensures safer flights outdoors.

D.reason_against: No special obstacle avoidance and smaller sensor.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli is a tech enthusiast focused on cutting-edge camera specs and performance.
personas.private_goal: Select the drone with the highest camera resolution and longest flight time.

A.reason_for: Offers the highest 5.4K resolution and 31-minute flight time.

B.reason_against: Lower camera specs and smaller sensor.

C.reason_against: Heaviest and shortest range reduce appeal.

D.reason_for: Long flight time and lightweight design.
D.reason_against: Smaller sensor limits image quality compared to A.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina is a travel lover who values portability and ease of use above all.
personas.private_goal: Find the lightest drone with good enough video quality for outdoor events.

B.reason_for: Lightweight and portable with sufficient 4K resolution.

C.reason_against: Heavy and limited range reduce portability.

D.reason_against: Smaller sensor may limit image quality.
